Alleghany Del (Y) Holder Robeco Institutional Asset Management Has Trimmed Holding by $28.22 Million as Market Valuation Rose; Iconiq Capital Has Trimmed Its Holding in Alibaba Group Hldg LTD (BABA) by $2.71 Million 
April 22, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia 
Robeco Institutional Asset Management decreased its stake in Alleghany Corp Del (Y) by 97.73% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Robeco Institutional Asset Management sold 47,354 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.88% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 1,099 shares of the property-casualty insurers company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $656,000, down from 48,453 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Robeco Institutional Asset Management who had been investing in Alleghany Corp Del for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $9.05 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.47% or $2.75 during the last trading session, reaching $587.44. About 138,489 shares traded or 90.76% up from the average. Alleghany Corporation (NYSE:Y) has declined 2.82% since April 22, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 14.37% the S&P500. 
Iconiq Capital Llc decreased its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (BABA) by 2.48% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Iconiq Capital Llc sold 15,767 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 620,570 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $107.01 million, down from 636,337 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Iconiq Capital Llc who had been investing in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $460.22 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.26% or $2.28 during the last trading session, reaching $179.11. About 14.47M shares traded. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 68.29% since April 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 56.74% the S&P500. 
Analysts await Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) to report earnings on May, 4 before the open. They expect $0.71 EPS, up 82.05% or $0.32 from last year’s $0.39 per share. BABA’s profit will be $1.82 billion for 63.07 P/E if the $0.71 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.34 actual EPS reported by Alibaba Group Holding Limited for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -47.01% negative EPS growth. 
Iconiq Capital Llc, which manages about $7.58 billion and $969.52 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Facebook Inc (NASDAQ:FB) by 3,121 shares to 373,317 shares, valued at $65.88M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Ishares Tr (ACWI) by 43,219 shares in the quarter, for a total of 2.42M shares, and has risen its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL). 
Among 38 analysts covering Alibaba ( NYSE:BABA ), 36 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 95% are positive. Alibaba had 171 analyst reports since August 12, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm has “Overweight” rating by Morgan Stanley given on Saturday, August 29. The rating was maintained by RBC Capital Markets with “Buy” on Monday, August 14. Needham maintained Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) rating on Friday, August 18. Needham has “Buy” rating and $190.0 target. As per Friday, August 18, the company rating was maintained by Stifel Nicolaus.
